preconditions.description: The input string S is non-empty.
The length of string S does not exceed 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: String S consists only of lowercase Latin letters and digits.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(count * count for count in {c: stdin.strip().count(c) for c in set(stdin.strip())}.values())
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of ordered pairs (i, j) such that S[i] equals S[j], computed as the sum of squares of the frequency of each distinct character in S.
